summary.reception: On January 14, 2024, the film won the title of Most Influential Film of the Year at the 2023 Weibo Night; in February, it was nominated for the Best Asian Chinese Film at the 42nd Hong Kong Film Awards. On Rotten Tomatoes, the film has an approval rating of 95% based on 19 reviews. Metacritic, which uses a weighted average, assigned the film a score of 75 out of 100, based on 7 critics, indicating "generally favorable reviews".
summary.story: Full River Red (Chinese: 满江红) is a 2023 period film directed by Zhang Yimou. It stars Shen Teng and Jackson Yee, alongside Zhang Yi, Lei Jiayin and Yue Yunpeng. The film was released in theaters in China on January 22, 2023, the same day as the Chinese New Year Day. It tells the story of a group of righteous men who sacrificed their lives to eradicate evil. Among them, the characters Zhang Da played by Shen Teng and Sun Jun played by Jackson Yee also have their own mysterious color, which makes people imagine endlessly.
